title: Native email creation brief
description: Shared creation wrapper and native editor draft. The build replaces message with the installed provider's schema from reference/creation-policy.json; the builder validates that policy and the completed native model.

message.description: Stripo create_email metadata. Title/preheader belong in model.metadata.

referenceMode.description: Local generation policy; do not send to MCP. copy-action is a legacy alias for tailored.

model.description: Native editor model draft, including metadata.title and metadata.preheader {text, fillSpace} when requested, resources.fonts and fontFamily settings. IDs and default settings may be omitted; native metadata, settings, resources, and block types from a reference are preserved. The bundled editor contract validates the completed model. The builder also limits new or changed metadata text to 500 UTF-16 code units; unchanged longer text requires the acquired rebuild target supplied through --baseline.
